Subject: Renewal orchestration: term extension + growth sprint — timeline & QBR availability

Team —

Acme Payments' renewal is up in 90 days. They are evaluating a 12->24 month term extension and are interested in a committed throughput uplift (roughly +35% capacity) to support an internal pilot. I want to get ahead of scheduling the QBR and lock a mutual action plan so we don't get stalled on procurement.

Key asks for this thread:
- Draft timeline (internal owners + dates) for term negotiation, procurement, and onboarding of additional capacity
- Confirm who will own pricing & discount ask (Marcus?) and who will own technical onboarding (Vivek)
- Get 3 candidate QBR time slots to propose to Beth at Acme

I've attached a short Renewal_Playbook_v1 and a capacity worksheet to baseline numbers. Can everyone reply with: owner + 3 availability windows (next 7 business days) + any open risks you foresee?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake

Putting myself down to lead pricing and commercial terms. Quick notes:
- Baseline seat/throughput numbers from the worksheet look right; increasing committed throughput by ~35% should be priced as a capacity tier upgrade (renewal amendment) rather than a usage overage change.
- Recommend a short-term incentive: 5% list discount for a 24-month commit + 90-day deployment milestone credit ($Xk) to accelerate adoption.
- I can produce a draft term amendment by EOD Wed.

Availability (same windows as Laura for coordination):

Beth — thanks, that timeline is super helpful.

Quick answers and next steps:
- Provisioning SLA: we can commit to delivering the pilot capacity by 10/10 provided we execute the amendment by Sep 1 and we have the standard provisioning window (30 days). I'll have Vivek confirm the deployment playbook and any infra prerequisites by Monday.
- Commercials: Marcus will share a draft amendment with a 5% list discount for a 24-month commit + a $25k deployment milestone credit. We will structure it as an amendment so procurement has a single doc to review.
- QBR: we're holding Tue Sep 14: 11:00–12:00 ET as the preferred slot. Laura will send the calendar invite and a pre-read.
